title: Reading request bodies
summary: Accept data sent with POST by adding express.json() and reading req.body.

quiz.q: Why is new data, such as a whole student record, sent in the request body instead of in the URL?
options: URLs are limited in length and visible, so bigger or private data goes in the request body
Servers refuse any data in a URL
The body is faster than the URL
quiz.explain: A **request body** can hold larger and structured data, such as a whole JSON object, and it does not appear in the address bar or browser history.

quiz.q: Complete the line so Express can read JSON bodies for every route below it.
quiz.explain: `express.json()` is middleware. `app.use` runs it for each request, and it fills `req.body` when the body is JSON.

quiz.q: In Express 5, what is `req.body` if you forgot `express.json()` and a client posts JSON?
quiz.explain: Without a body parser nobody reads the body, so `req.body` is `undefined`. Using it, as in `req.body.name`, then throws a TypeError.

quiz.q: The client sends POST /echo with the JSON body `{"city":"Pune"}`. What does it receive?
quiz.explain: The parsed object is `{ city: 'Pune' }`, so `req.body.city` is the text Pune.

quiz.q: Click the line that makes `req.body` empty for this route.
quiz.explain: Middleware only affects routes registered after it. `app.use(express.json())` must come before `app.post`, otherwise the route runs first and the body is never parsed.

exercise.task:
In `app.js`:

- Add `express.json()` so JSON bodies are parsed.
- `POST /echo` sends back the JSON body it received.
- `POST /students` takes a body like `{ "name": "Asha", "marks": 82 }`, adds a student to the `students` array with a new `id` (the next number, starting at 1), and answers with status `201` and the new student `{ id, name, marks }`.
- `GET /students` (already there) lists the array.

Leave `module.exports = app;` at the bottom.
hints: Put `app.use(express.json());` near the top, before your routes. Then the body is available as `req.body`.
Create the student with `{ id: students.length + 1, name: req.body.name, marks: req.body.marks }`, `students.push(student)` it, then answer with `res.status(201).json(student)`.
